<style>
#title-block-header {
  display: none;
}

/* Uses shared tokens from styles.css: --accent, --bg-secondary, --text-secondary, --border */

.projects-shell {
  max-width: 96rem;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 3rem clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 3.5rem) 5rem;
}

.projects-kicker {
  margin: 0 0 0.45rem;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.projects-title {
  margin: 0 0 0.9rem;
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.6vw, 3rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.05;
}

.projects-intro {
  max-width: 52rem;
  margin: 0 0 2.4rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.75;
}

.project-stack {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.project-card {
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 1.35rem;
  background: var(--bg-secondary);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

.project-card:hover {
  border-color: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.3);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
}

.project-card summary {
  list-style: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.project-card summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}

.project-summary {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.08fr) minmax(20rem, 0.92fr);
  gap: 1.5rem;
  padding: 1.55rem;
}

.project-copy {
  min-width: 0;
}

.project-tags {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
}

.project-tag {
  padding: 0.32rem 0.7rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
}

.project-name-row {
  display: flex;

  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
}

.project-name-group {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;

}

.project-number {

  border-radius: 999px;

  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.project-name {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1.28rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.project-toggle {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.project-card[open] .project-toggle::before {
  content: "Hide details";
}

.project-card:not([open]) .project-toggle::before {
  content: "Expand";
}

.project-preview-copy {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 0.96rem;
  line-height: 1.72;
}

.project-preview-panel {
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  min-height: 14rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 1rem;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.project-preview-custom {
  width: 100%;

  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  background:

}

.project-preview-title {
  margin: 0;

  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.project-preview-lines {

  gap: 0.45rem;
}

.project-preview-line {

  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 0.87rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.project-preview-metrics {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

.project-preview-metric {
  padding: 0.45rem 0.7rem;

  color: var(--accent);

}

.project-body {

  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.project-body-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(17rem, 0.85fr);
  gap: 1.25rem;
  padding-top: 1.2rem;
}

.project-detail-copy {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  line-height: 1.72;
}

.project-detail-copy p {
  margin: 0 0 0.9rem;
}

.project-detail-copy p:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.project-detail-list {
  margin: 0;
  padding-left: 1.15rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.project-detail-list li + li {
  margin-top: 0.45rem;
}

.project-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  align-content: flex-start;
}

.project-action {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 0.8rem 1rem;
  border-radius: 0.9rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, opacity 0.15s ease;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
}

.project-action.primary {
  background: var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
}

.project-action.primary:hover,
.project-action.primary:focus {
  color: #fff;
  opacity: 0.92;
}

@media (max-width: 980px) {
  .project-summary,
  .project-body-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .project-name-row {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .projects-shell {
    padding: 2.5rem 1rem 4rem;
  }
}

            <p class="project-preview-copy">
              ROS 2 C++ packages that bridge Vicon and OptiTrack motion-capture systems to the PX4 autopilot EKF for indoor quadrotor flight experiments.
            </p>
          </div>
          <div class="project-preview-panel">
            <div class="project-preview-custom">

        <div class="project-body-grid">

            <p>
              Vicon4PX4 and OptiTrack4PX4 handle the full pipeline — coordinate frame conversion, quaternion reordering, PX4 timestamping, and full-state merging — so you can focus on your controller, not the plumbing. Adopted by Georgia Tech's Indoor Flight Lab as part of its official codebase.
            </p>
            <ul class="project-detail-list">
              <li>Connects via DataStream SDK (Vicon) or NatNet (OptiTrack) — vendored, no system install.</li>
              <li>Publishes <code>VehicleOdometry</code> on <code>/fmu/in/vehicle_visual_odometry</code> for direct EKF fusion.</li>
              <li>Both packages share the same ROS 2 interface design.</li>
            </ul>
          </div>

              <li>Dependency-aware incremental builds keep edits fast.</li>

      <div class="project-body">
        <div class="project-body-grid">
          <div class="project-detail-copy">
            <p>
              CodeGraph Live fixes the stale-graph problem in AI-assisted development. This fork adds a systemd user service that watches all your initialized projects simultaneously via Linux inotify — every save from any editor is detected and synced within one second, even when Claude Code is completely closed.
            </p>
            <ul class="project-detail-list">
              <li>Background daemon auto-discovers new projects by scanning <code>$HOME</code> every 30s.</li>
              <li>Claude Code hooks keep Claude's own edits in sync mid-session.</li>
              <li>MCP server exposes graph query tools so Claude navigates call graphs instead of grepping files.</li>
            </ul>

    <details class="project-card">

              <div class="project-name-group">
                <span class="project-number">04</span>
                <p class="project-name">relay</p>
              </div>
              <span class="project-toggle"></span>
            </div>
            <p class="project-preview-copy">
              A bash orchestration script that runs a four-step Plan → Code → Review → Cleanup loop over a dependency-ordered task list, dispatching each step to a fresh Claude or Codex subprocess so nothing leaks between tasks.
            </p>
          </div>
          <div class="project-preview-panel">
            <div class="project-preview-custom">
              <p class="project-preview-title">Multi-agent pipeline, no config required</p>
              <div class="project-preview-lines">
                <div class="project-preview-line">Plan → Code → Review → Cleanup per task</div>
                <div class="project-preview-line">Beads (<code>bd</code>) for dependency-ordered task tracking</div>
                <div class="project-preview-line">Drop-in: copy pipeline.sh, run it</div>
              </div>
              <div class="project-preview-metrics">
                <span class="project-preview-metric">Bash</span>
                <span class="project-preview-metric">Claude Code</span>
                <span class="project-preview-metric">Codex</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </summary>
      <div class="project-body">
        <div class="project-body-grid">
          <div class="project-detail-copy">
            <p>
              relay automates the full agentic development loop. Each task from <code>prd.json</code> is handed to a fresh Claude subprocess to plan, a fresh Codex subprocess to implement, another to adversarially review the diff, and a final Claude pass to clean up — with no state leaking between steps.
            </p>
            <ul class="project-detail-list">
              <li>Uses Beads (<code>bd</code>) to resolve task dependencies and claim tasks atomically before starting.</li>
              <li>Context-rot guard: 10m session cap with git-state handoff into a fresh subprocess.</li>
              <li>No daemon, no server, no install — just copy <code>pipeline.sh</code> into your project's <code>.claude/</code> directory.</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
          <div class="project-actions">
            <a class="project-action primary" href="../projects/relay/">Open Project Page</a>
            <a class="project-action" href="https://github.com/evannsmc/relay" target="_blank">GitHub ↗</a>
          </div>
        </div>
